Found Solution and will change this back to positive if it is Fixed by Steam and Origin.

I think the problem may be that the digital hand shake is not happening correctly between accounts from Steam to Origin and back.

I paid for a full year of EA (and origin essentially) through steam -- on Origin... it says my membership has expired...

Solution -

1. First on the search bar on your desktop, search "Run". There will be an Icon of a blue rectangle, click it.

2. Then type in C:/ProgramData/Electronic Arts

3. Then you'll find in the folder called "License"

4. Delete the "License" Folder

5. Try out to see if the game start up. If not it might be a corrupted save file or cloud sync is turned on in origin


At first, this did not work

Ultimate solution for me was to do the above process suggestion -> (Then) Disable cloud in Origin -> Disable both Steam AND Origin overlay/in game -> Reboot PC then relaunch -> game now runs successfully

....... We will see how long that lasts.

Update: well after deleting the License data over and over and over and over.... and over again...
